Overview of Bihar BSSC Field Assistant Mains 2026

The Bihar Staff Selection Commission (BSSC) has released the official notice regarding the Mains examination application process for the Field Assistant recruitment 2025. This recruitment drive aims to fill a total of 201 positions. Candidates who are qualified to participate in the mains stage can review the official schedule and requirements before proceeding with their online submissions.

Important Dates and Application Timeline

The online application window for the BSSC Field Assistant Mains opens on October 22, 2026, and will remain active until October 31, 2026. Applicants must complete their submissions and fee payments within this designated schedule.

  • Online Application Start Date: October 22, 2026
  • Online Application Last Date: October 31, 2026
  • Application Fee (General/BC/EBC): ₹540

Eligibility Criteria and Age Limits

Candidates intending to apply must meet specific educational and age parameters set by the commission:

  • Educational Qualification: Candidates must have passed the Intermediate (10+2) examination or hold a Diploma in Agriculture from a recognized institute or university. Equivalent academic degrees or alternative qualifications are not accepted for this post.
  • Age Limits: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, while the maximum age ranges from 37 to 42 years, calculated as of August 1, 2024. Age relaxations apply according to official BSSC regulations.

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

When applying for public sector recruitment in India, candidates should independently verify all notifications directly through official channels rather than relying solely on secondary summaries.

  • What is Confirmed: The total number of vacancies (201 positions), the application window (October 22 to October 31, 2026), application fee structure for specified categories, and baseline educational requirements.
  • What is Unknown: Specific category-wise sub-quotas and exact examination dates for the mains paper are subject to further official announcements.
  • How to Verify: Readers can review the detailed guidelines, check notices, and access the portal via the BSSC Official Website Notice Board or reference the primary information portal at Sarkari Result. Always read the official notification thoroughly before submitting any personal details or online application fees.
